transcript.text:
Here are the API calls in sequence, using the Client Credentials grant flow (appropriate for scripts/automation):

---

## Step 1 — Authenticate

Exchange your PAT's Client ID and Secret for a JWT access token:

```bash
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials
&client_id={clientId}
&client_secret={clientSecret}
```

Extract `access_token` from the response. All subsequent calls use:
```
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

---

## Step 2 — Create the Campaign

```bash
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "Q3 Access Review",
  "description": "Quarterly manager certification",
  "type": "MANAGER",
  "deadline": "2026-08-31T00:00:00Z"
}
```

For a search-based campaign (e.g., certifying specific identities), use `type: "SEARCH"` and include a `filter` or search query in the body. The response includes the new campaign's `id`.

---

## Step 3 — Activate the Campaign

The campaign starts in a preview state. Once you're satisfied with it, activate it:

```bash
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{campaignId}/activate
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: application/json

{}
```

This pushes the campaign to reviewers as active certifications.

---

## Step 4 — Check Campaign Status

Poll the campaign to see its current state:

```bash
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{campaignId}
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

---

## Step 5 — Pull Results / Reports

List available reports for the campaign:

```bash
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{campaignId}/reports
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

Trigger a specific report (e.g., certification results):

```bash
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{campaignId}/reports/{reportType}
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

Common `reportType` values include `CAMPAIGN_COMPOSITION_REPORT` and `CERTIFICATION_DECISION_REPORT`.

---

> **Note:** The documentation excerpts provided confirm operation names but not full versioned paths. The `/v3/campaigns` paths above follow SailPoint's standard ISC API conventions. Verify against the full API reference if your tenant uses a different version segment.
